decisions.statement: Create a new owner-authorized phase and supersede the previous pointer; never silently amend the old plan.
Visible/headed remains the default; headless stays explicit CI/owner mode and is never a silent fallback.
The guardian performs non-activating placement only and fails closed on provider self-activation (race guard).
No live GUI launch is attempted while the host is actively used by the owner; live acceptance is BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER with manual commands when evidence cannot be isolated.
No process kill, no global user config edit, no global install, no commit/push/deploy.
